name: Rage Scar Yeti Hide
summary: Rage Scar Yeti Hide comes from the yetis of Rage Scar Hold in northern Feralas. Pratt McGrubben and Jangdor Swiftstrider seek the hides for their work with leather.

sections.title: A Better Hide
sections.body: In northern Feralas, the yetis of Rage Scar Hold yield hides that leatherworkers prize. Pratt McGrubben at Feathermoon Stronghold and Jangdor Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache each seek ten for their work. They hope the hides will prove as resilient as thorium once cured.

faq.q: Where do Rage Scar Yeti Hides come from?
faq.answer: Rage Scar Yeti Hides come from the yetis in Rage Scar Hold, in northern Feralas.
Pratt McGrubben at Feathermoon Stronghold and Jangdor Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache both seek Rage Scar Yeti Hides.
The hide may be exceptionally resilient once cured, which makes it promising for leatherwork.
Pratt McGrubben and Jangdor Swiftstrider each ask for ten Rage Scar Yeti Hides.
